description: Integer Math node with linked inputs (each operand the sum of two face attributes): every operation at its edges where the pinned code is defined (division and modulo by zero, power with negative and large exponents, GCD and LCM with signs and zero, INT_MIN and INT_MAX without overflow); the result in the AOVs D0..D3 (base-256 digits, D3 signed) and R; one cell per case
